_help: The words in the Tidy up panel. Use {n} for a count and {list} for names. 'one|many' picks singular or plural.

overlap.title: {n} {label} overlap
overlap.why: {list}. Claude may pick any of them. Keep the ones you name on purpose.

unused.title: {n} skill never used|{n} skills never used
unused.why: {list}. Remove what you do not recognise. Keep ones that wait for a later job. Fewer skills also shortens the list Claude reads every turn.

stale.title: {n} skill quiet for {days}+ days|{n} skills quiet for {days}+ days

deadAgents.title: {n} agent never called|{n} agents never called

pluginsOff.title: {n} plugin off and never used|{n} plugins off and never used

twins.title: {n} skill exists twice|{n} skills exist twice
twins.why: {list}. The project copy can drift from the global one. Keep one.

unknown.title: {n} skill with no known source|{n} skills with no known source

longList.title: The skill list is long
longList.why: About {tokens} tokens of skill text are listed to Claude each turn. Fewer skills means better picks.
